notes.title: Call of VII Update 1.01
notes.content:
This is the first update of Call of VII, thanks for all the love and suggestions.

According to the feedback from player, we updated our game :


 We added several new background music to prevent the tedious experience of looping one song.
 We also added the function of adjusting character movement speed so that player can choose the comfortable speed as needed.
 We fixed the sound-effect bug of button and the bug of missing achievement.
 We adjusted the sequence of narrative to provide a better experience of story-telling.
